sectors.briefing:
Defensive and rate-sensitive sectors are rapidly gaining momentum, signaling a rotation to safety. Consumer Defensive (+3.7%), Real Estate (+3.3%), and Healthcare (+3.0%) led the market this week. Healthcare is showing particularly strong monthly momentum (+4.3%) as it recovers from its negative YTD position, while Financials are also quietly turning positive.

Conversely, high-beta growth and cyclical sectors are losing ground. Technology suffered a sharp 9.3% weekly decline, marking a severe short-term pullback. Basic Materials extended its monthly decline to -10.7% with a 7.9% weekly drop, while Consumer Cyclical remained the weakest YTD performer, down 3.6% on the week.

The key divergence is the stark split between Technology and Energy. Despite Tech’s weekly plunge, Energy has held steady (-1.2% on the week) to maintain its massive +29.1% YTD lead and top momentum score. Capital is clearly rotating out of expensive growth and into defensive yield and value anchors.
